title: Design Hit Counter
goal: Solve Design Hit Counter: Design a hit counter that tracks HTTP requests and returns count in last N seconds.
strategy: Design a hit counter that tracks HTTP requests and returns count in last N seconds.
edgeCases: Hits exactly at the expiry boundary no longer belong to the rolling window; multiple hits can share a timestamp.
inputRules: hits must be an array of timestamps
every hit timestamp must be a non-negative number
hit timestamps must be in non-decreasing order
timestamp must be a non-negative number
window must be a positive number
